title: Mozart · Piano Sonata No. 16 in C major, K. 545 · I. Allegro
explanation: Mozart’s C-major Sonata facile opens with a clear Allegro in 4/4. Its bright C-major home and balanced phrases make it ideal for practicing articulation, repeated accompaniment patterns, and clean classical voicing.
